definitions.gloss: full of troubles; eventful; turbulent times
definitions.explanation: A period marked by many difficulties and problems.

examples.japanese: {今年|ことし}は{多事多難|たじたなん}な{一年|いちねん}だった。
examples.english: This year was a turbulent one.

examples.japanese: {会社|かいしゃ}は{多事多難|たじたなん}の{時期|じき}を{乗|の}り{越|こ}えた。
examples.english: The company overcame a difficult period.

examples.japanese: {多事多難|たじたなん}な{船出|ふなで}となったが、なんとか{成功|せいこう}した。
examples.english: It was a troubled start, but we managed to succeed.

notes:
STRUCTURE (YOJIJUKUGO):
{多|た} (many) + {事|じ} (matters) + {多|た} (many) + {難|なん} (difficulties)
Literal: "many matters, many difficulties"

USAGE:
・{多事多難|たじたなん}な{時代|じだい} (turbulent era)
・{多事多難|たじたなん}な{一年|いちねん} (eventful year)
・{多事多難|たじたなん}の{時期|じき} (troubled times)

CONTEXTS:
Often used to describe historical periods, business conditions, or personal circumstances marked by numerous challenges.

OPPOSITE:
・{平穏無事|へいおんぶじ} - peaceful and uneventful
